final_response: Followed up with the customer and requested the missing diagnostics. I also added a note to the incident ticket and marked the email as read.

args.body:
Hi Riley,

Following up on the webhook retry incident. To continue troubleshooting, could you please send the missing diagnostics when you have a moment?

Please include:
- Approximate timestamps of the failed/retried webhook deliveries
- Relevant request or event IDs / webhook IDs
- Endpoint response codes and any response body snippets
- Any logs from your side around the incident window
- Confirmation of whether the issue is still ongoing or has stabilized

Once we have those details, we can continue the investigation.

Thanks,
args.title: Re: Webhook Retry customer incident

args.comment_text: Sent follow-up to customer (riley@client.com) requesting missing diagnostics: incident timestamps, request/event IDs, endpoint response codes/body snippets, customer-side logs, and current status.
